principle: Expansion and new construction are consequences of sustained evidence, not one-time queue spikes.
rules: Single emergencies or temporary wartime spikes do not automatically justify permanent expansion.
Sustained queue saturation must be demonstrated across an evaluation window appropriate to service type.
Expand the existing facility before building a nearby duplicate when site/topology/sovereignty and economics make expansion preferable.
A second facility requires residual demand, resilience, sovereignty or strategic separation that expansion cannot satisfy.
War can shorten planning/construction thresholds but creates postwar overcapacity risk.
Postwar or economic drawdown can mothball modules, reduce staffing or decommission the facility.
Abandoned capacity remains physical/history state and may later be reactivated or repurposed.
ai_boundary: AI may recommend expansion/drawdown from authoritative history; it cannot declare chronic saturation from a single player visit.
